title: harness: cd-noise-guard (cd to current dir is a no-op)
desc: Blocks commands that cd/Set-Location to the current working directory. This is a no-op that wastes a command slot.
steps: SAFETY: Catches 'cd X', 'Set-Location X', or 'sl X' where X resolves to the current working directory. This is a no-op command -- it does nothing but consume tokens and a tool call slot.

SOLUTION: Remove the 'cd <current-dir>' prefix from your command. The shell is already in the correct directory. Use absolute paths if you need to reference files in another location, but never prepend cd to git/wkappbot commands.

PREVENTION: Always use absolute paths in tool calls. Never prepend cd to a command -- set CWD on the tool call itself or use absolute paths. The harness CWD is already correct at every tool invocation.

requirements.expect: cd to current dir is a no-op
